acceptance_criteria: For each significant interaction gene (from T2S3), the per-timepoint condition contrast (log2FC treated-vs-control at t0, t1, t2, t3, shrunken values from T2S2) forms its trajectory vector

A second pass is run against Reactome human pathways (confirmed present, current release) as the follow-up collection

plan.title: Condition x Time Interaction DE Beyond Shared Time Trend
plan.analytical_narrative: The design is 2 conditions x 4 time points (t0-t3), 3 replicates per cell (n=25 samples/24 metadata rows: check for one extra/missing sample during QC), salmon-derived raw gene counts (12000 genes x 25 samples). The research question — which genes change over time in a treatment-specific way, beyond the shared time trend — is a condition-by-time interaction question. We fit DESeq2 with design ~condition*time (time as a 4-level factor, condition as 2-level factor, both with explicit reference levels: t0 as reference time, and the untreated/control condition as reference condition, confirmed from metadata during QC). After sample-structure QC and a minimal low-count filter, the core test is the DESeq2 Wald test on the interaction coefficients (condition:time_tX terms) with apeglm shrinkage — genes with a significant, non-zero interaction coefficient at one or more time points show a treatment-specific deviation from the trend common to both arms, which is exactly what a model with only main effects (~condition+time) cannot capture. We additionally extract the simple effect of condition at each time point (Wald contrasts) so the interaction result can be read alongside where in time the divergence occurs. BH-adjusted p-values (alpha=0.05) with independent filtering select the significant interaction genes; their per-timepoint condition-difference trajectories (log2FC(treated vs control) at t0..t3) are then clustered to summarize distinct temporal patterns of treatment-specific divergence, satisfying the requirement that a time-course finding is reported as a trajectory, not a single fold change. Ranked GSEA (on the interaction Wald statistic) against Hallmark and Reactome gene sets contextualizes which pathways carry a treatment-specific temporal signature. All steps use only DESeq2/apeglm/fgsea/clusterProfiler/mclust which are confirmed present in the sandbox, and MSigDB Hallmark, MSigDB GO, and Reactome GMTs confirmed present under /mnt/refs for human enrichment.
